units.source_text: 然而，我们俩正摆五子棋，姑娘们就过了桥，嘎嘎地登上二楼来了。

en.t: However, while the two of us were playing gomoku, the girls crossed the bridge and came clattering up to the second floor.

units.source_text: 和往常一样，她们郑重地施了礼，接着依次跪坐在走廊上，踟蹰不前。

en.t: As usual, they bowed solemnly, then knelt one after another in the corridor, hesitating to come any farther.

units.source_text: 第一个站起来的，是千代子。

en.t: The first one to stand up was Chiyoko.
